column1: # Rows db.rf1.* (line DBID item rf-1, 2026-11-27; DBID DECISIONS 62 (22); fixtures make_multidb.py --rf1-only): a query batch whose subjects' loads look up a taxid (bsub, 9606) with BLASTDB=tests/seqdb/taxdb/btd_empty, an empty taxdb.btd, which NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 maps as a null pointer: the lookup reads a record and NCBI crashes (SIGSEGV, exit 139) at that load, in every program and at 1 and 4 threads. LOSAT refuses there (rule 3 of PD-LOSAT-NCBI-DEFECTS) after the reports of the batches before, as for NCBI's own error of a batch (blastinput::app::ErrorAfterBatchReports, made in one place: algorithm::common::database::batch_loads_error): .b2. BATCH_SIZE=1, rf1_q0e (q0_nohit, then bsub's letters, whose batch's prefetch loads bsub); .r2. BATCH_SIZE=1 PRE_FETCH_SEQS_LIMIT=0, rf1_re (pfo_r, then bsub's letters, whose report loads bsub; outfmt 0 with -num_alignments 0, as NCBI's run with the alignments ends at pfo_r's first alignment, exit 2); .b1.0 one batch (psiblast, which searches each query alone: rf1_e, bsub's letters), the prolog; all with -evalue 1e-10. Each takes its stdout from the first bytes of NCBI's run of the batches before alone (.q0., .r.), its end left out as NCBI's own error of that batch leaves it. Rows .t. (R1): tblastn's report of taxfilter/tfe_nr shows the title that NCBI makes from OID 3's taxid (an empty stored title, 9606), whose lookup reads a record of the empty taxdb.btd, where NCBI crashes at OID 3's load: .t2. BATCH_SIZE=1, rf1_q0t (q0_nohit, then P69905), the prefetch on and (.np.) off; .t1.20 one batch (taxfilter/q.faa), the field line. LOSAT refuses at that batch with the refusal of OID 3's load, in its words, as at the loads (algorithm::common::database::null_mapped_refusal, TBLASTN's algorithm::tblastn::database::title_stop; review 1 M1), after the reports of the batches before (.t.q0.: q0_nohit alone, without -evalue).
